reviews.comment: **FOR 363** He does a great job making tough material manageable. His tests are easy because he repeats some problems from class/recitation, so you're guaranteed a B if you just show up. The class can be a little abstract, but he cares a lot about your learning. Please just go to office hours if you get lost trust me, he'll help you.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Caring

reviews.comment: FOR 363***. Dr. Hasnain wasn't awful for this class, as he recognized the material was hard and tried to meet us halfway. Tests are incredibly difficult however which led to a poor average. Homeworks and recitations were helpful to learning, and he curved the class heavily. Overall, not the worst option for 363.
Worst class I've taken my entire life

368 is one of the hardest classes that you will take as a MEEN major but Dr. Hasnain is one of your best chances to do decent, he is great at dumbing down the hard topics and putting it in a perspective that is easier to students to understand. Either way this class is very hard and you will probably hate it no matter who your prof is

MEEN364 is by far one of the most difficult courses and the lab portion only makes it worse, however, Dr. Hasnain is your best shot at doing well. The class felt extremely overwhelming at times but that is simply due to the course material. Lectures were very well structured and homework was good practice for exams.

This class is very difficult to understand already but this prof is understanding on the difficulty and will work with the students. As long as you understand how to do the problem you will pass the course. He grades leniently and pretty much passes you if you work hard and show youve tried hard to understand each topic.

Dr. Hasnain is an incredibly caring professor and his grading criteria is awesome. Even though 364 was a very confusing class, he understood that and was very lenient with test grades and homework grades. As long as you get a basic idea on the process of each problem given to you, you can make an easy B in the class.
